_source: design-discussion-personalities-archetypes.md v5 + Oct 8 (A Keeper). spawnWeight equal = PROPOSAL (not decided).

personalities.name: Professional
personalities.effect: Steady form, slightly faster growth. No standout perk.

personalities.name: Lucky Charm
personalities.effect: Adds luck to the whole team (fewer injuries, cards and bad events; better odds). Stacks: each extra Lucky Charm adds 20% less than the previous one (10%, +8% = 18%, +6.4% = 24.4%, …), which levels off near 50%.

personalities.name: Leader
personalities.effect: Lifts team morale, but gets unhappy quickly when benched.

personalities.name: Warrior
personalities.effect: Less likely to be carded when fouling. (No downside.)

personalities.name: Loyal
personalities.effect: Easy to renew, but refuses to be transferred.

personalities.name: Diva
personalities.effect: Morale crashes when benched; harder to renew. (No upside.)

personalities.name: Maverick
personalities.effect: Unpredictable: more brilliant matches, but also more bad ones.

personalities.name: Businessman
personalities.effect: Good morale, but asks for higher wages when signing or renewing.

personalities.name: Socialite
personalities.effect: Keeps his own and the team's morale up, but his energy recovers slower.

personalities.name: A Keeper
personalities.effect: Any outfield position, never a natural GK. Comes only with the A Keeper archetype, and every A Keeper has it. It's his only personality and is revealed by scouting like any other. It flags that he can go in goal. No other effect: the archetype does the work.
